GVS perfboard build guide

Particle FeatherWing Tripler · col 4 = HV bus · col 6 = GND bus · gold pairs = header pins (bussed between sections; only the XIAO and the listed jumpers touch them). Layout checked hole-by-hole against the circuit and simulated in ngspice (0 mA idle, 1 / 2 mA exact, 19.5 V max boost, shorted-transistor fault caught).

Whole board with every wire (tap to open)

Work one section at a time: back bridges first, then parts lowest to tallest, then insulated wires. Pinch the pictures to zoom; turn your phone sideways.
